name: MANOVA
when_to_use: Compare three or more groups on several metric dependent variables simultaneously, instead of running one ANOVA per variable.
notes: Like ANOVA, but compares several numeric outcomes at once across groups, instead of one by one. Applications: compare 3 marketing campaigns on sales, clicks and retention simultaneously.

expected_input.question: Do the groups differ when several metrics are evaluated together?

plain_explanation.purpose: Compares groups on several numbers at the same time, instead of one at a time.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there is more than one outcome measure and you want a single verdict.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Several numeric outcome columns and a group column.
plain_explanation.example: Compare three training methods on reading and math scores together.
plain_explanation.diagram: groups A, B, C x measures 1, 2 -> do they differ overall?
